name: V Rising
description: Gothic vampire survival — build your castle and rule the night. Windows dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).
notes: The server binary is Windows-only (it also runs under Wine/Proton on Linux hosts outside this blueprint's platform list). Detailed settings live in save-data\Settings\ServerHostSettings.json and ServerGameSettings.json — copy the defaults from VRisingServer_Data\StreamingAssets\Settings\ on first setup. Saves are kept inside .\save-data so panel backups include them.
